summary: NNN REIT, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a new at-the-market equity distribution agreement covering up to 25 million common shares, replacing its prior 2023 ATM program. The company simultaneously entered into master forward confirmations with multiple banks, enabling forward sale agreements, including contingent forward transactions. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, likely including property acquisitions and debt repayment. This is a capital-raising event, not a special-situation transaction. Watch for dilution impact and execution pace; no board recommendation or deal terms disclosed.
